title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・限界の先へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka lives up to her moniker of the Otherworldly Front-Runner and takes first at the autumn Tenno Sho in a whirlwind victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cheers of celebration for her victory ring out over the Tokyo Racecourse for what seems like forever.
